title: Anisotropic product noise kernel
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability distribution $\pi$, and let $n$ be a natural number. Given an input $x\in\Omega^n$ and coordinate parameters $\rho_i\in[0,1]$ for every $i$, define the anisotropic product noise kernel to be the probability distribution on $\Omega^n$ obtained by independently applying the coordinate noise distribution with parameter $\rho_i$ to $x_i$ at each coordinate $i$.
